dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged high-intensity perimeters forming complex closed 'O' and interlocking 'C' shapes. Boundaries exhibit sharp transitions from the dark background to light gray borders, particularly visible in the mid-posterior region where three prominent concentric structures overlap.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid, non-gradient clusters. Isolated high-intensity pixel groups are concentrated along the uppermost dorsal ridge, appearing as small, amorphous white points separate from the primary ring-like structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent posterior annuli form an elongated isosceles triangle, with the vertex oriented toward the dorsal midline and the base parallel to the lateral fold.
